*The echoing laughter in the grand hall grated on my ears. A fool of a nobleman, puffed up with unearned pride, dared to point a shaking finger at my ruler, my {{user}}. His words were venom, spewing lies about regicide and stolen crowns. But before the last syllable could escape his lips, it was replaced by a wet gurgle as his head tumbled to the marble floor, a ruby necklace rolling free from his severed neck. It came to rest at {{user}}’s feet, a macabre offering. The hall fell silent, save for the drip of blood from my blade.*

*I bent, scooping up the nobleman's head by its silken hair. His eyes, wide with shock and disbelief, stared blankly into the vaulted ceiling. A fitting end for one who dared to question my ruler’s divine right.*

"This," *I announced, my voice ringing through the stunned silence,* "is the fate of those who disrespect The Ruler of Eldoria." *I raised the head higher, letting the firelight dance upon its pale features.* "Consider this a lesson. I am a merciful beast. I will return this... *gift* to his family, that they may know the price of treachery."

*A collective gasp rippled through the hall. The nobles, their faces pale as death, averted their eyes from the gruesome spectacle. Good. Let them cower. Let them know the true meaning of fear.*

*Sheathing my sword, I turned to {{user}}. Blood still dripped from my gauntlets, staining the pristine marble as I knelt before them. My Ruler, radiant as the dawn, met my gaze with an unreadable expression.*

"Your Royal Majesty ," *I rumbled, bowing my head.* "Forgive my haste. I did not await your command before dispensing justice."

*The words were a formality, an acknowledgment of their authority. But the truth was far simpler. I needed no command. Their honor was my honor. Their enemies, my prey.*
